curator: YonkouJean PGO infographic — Great League teams recommended/used by top GBL players, GBL Season 27 (Aug 2026)
extraction: Orchestrator read team images supplied by Jaxon (2026-08-21). Members are pvpoke speciesIds ('_shadow' suffix = shadow form, matching vendor training-preset convention). Entries with uncertain:true carry a note about the flagged read — advisory for humans; loaders treat all entries alike and must skip-with-warning any speciesId that fails to resolve, dropping a team whole if ANY member fails (2 mons isn't a team). Core-breaker strips in the YonkouJean images are the teams' counters, deliberately NOT included. Teams with tier:'off-meta' come from a second batch (Japanese Nature-Cup party infographics + player battle-party screenshots + one English player party): Jaxon wants them in the opponent pool for surface diversity, at reduced sampling weight vs the untagged (meta) teams. JP entries were identified primarily from printed katakana names (high confidence); in-game screenshots use a nickname-of-base-stage pattern resolved via CP feasibility (e.g. 'Frillish' at CP 1498 = Jellicent, pink female sprite). Entries id-prefixed 'yasseraleed-' are a third batch (GOALS T26, 2026-08-21): 13 untagged (meta) teams visually transcribed from stream screenshots by GBL streamer Yasser Aleed (twitch.tv/YasserAleed, YouTube aleed_yasser, Discord /thecoolkidz), supplied by Jaxon; where an on-screen team-builder card was visible its text is authoritative over a visual read (recorded in each team's 'notes'), and species-level shadow status is recorded only where the stream explicitly showed it (a shiny/cosmetic render is never treated as shadow). Entries id-prefixed 'jaxon-ladder-' are a fourth batch (GOALS T31, 2026-08-23): 7 untagged (meta, full weight — real opponents Jaxon actually faces on the GBL ladder) teams Jaxon reported directly from his own ladder games, speciesIds resolved and verified against the pinned gamemaster before being committed. FILE-WIDE LEAD DOCTRINE (Jaxon, 2026-08-23): for EVERY entry in this file, `members[0]` IS that team's established lead — for the pre-existing 46 entries that ordering came from the source images/screenshots (best available at the time); for 'jaxon-ladder-' entries it is Jaxon's own directly-observed opponent lead. src/meta/teams.js's loadCommunityTeams stamps `leadIndex: 0` on every returned team so scripts/evolve.mjs's opponentLeadIndex() reads it as declared data rather than falling through to its own index-0 default. The same first-member-is-lead convention applies to pvpoke's vendored gobattleleague training presets (no code change needed there — the loader's existing default already reads member index 0). Entries id-prefixed 'jaxon-ladder-13'/'jaxon-ladder-14' continue the fourth batch (2026-08-26): 2 more teams Jaxon reported from his own ladder games. Entries id-prefixed 'pvpoke-top-' are a fifth batch (2026-08-26): 2 Great League teams Jaxon took from PvPoke's own top-performing team listings — untagged (meta), same full weight as the rest. Entries id-prefixed 'high-ladder-' are a sixth batch (2026-08-26): 21 teams Jaxon supplied as high-ladder Great League compositions — untagged (meta), full weight. Every speciesId in all three of those batches was verified against the pinned gamemaster before commit, and each entry checked for duplication against both the pre-existing community entries and the 25 vendor gobattleleague presets (none were duplicates). Where a batch entry named an explicit moveset, the file has no per-member move-override plumbing (buildRecommendedMon builds from pvpoke’s recommended moveset alone), so the moveset is recorded in that entry’s `notes` and the divergence, if any, is stated there. Ambiguous forms in the high-ladder batch were resolved to Kanto (marowak_shadow, ninetales_shadow) per that batch’s own habit of naming regionals explicitly; the Marowak read is flagged in its notes for confirmation. TIER DOCTRINE (Jaxon, 2026-08-26): the 27 second-hand entries that predate the ladder batches (omarchm10 through yasseraleed-13 — YonkouJean infographic + Yasser Aleed stream transcriptions) are tagged tier:'recommended' and draw at HALF weight in the curated pool: they are teams a top player said to run, transcribed from an image, not opponents observed across the ladder. The 'jaxon-ladder-'/'jet-ladder-'/'pvpoke-top-'/'high-ladder-' batches stay untagged (meta, full weight), and tier:'off-meta' (surface diversity only) drops to a quarter weight — see src/meta/teams.js's CURATED_TIER_WEIGHTS. loadMetaTeams orders the merged pool by descending tier weight, so a small --meta limit reaches full-weight teams first. MEMBER MOVESETS: a member may now be an object ({speciesId, fastMove?, chargedMoves?}) instead of a bare speciesId, recording what an opponent was actually seen carrying when it differs from pvpoke’s recommendation; either move field may be omitted and merges independently over the recommendation. Three entries use it (high-ladder-11/16/19); every other member stays a bare string.
